title: Objection: 'Will I feel results right away?'
body: Some people notice an early difference, especially with energy and focus products, but the full benefit builds over 3 to 6 months of consistent use, so don't judge it too early. Does that make sense?

title: Objection: 'Can this replace my medication?'
body: No. It is a complementary tool alongside a healthy lifestyle and any treatment your doctor prescribes. Please keep taking what your doctor has given you exactly as instructed.
